title: Scope statement
description: Define the exact scope of the SPI programme (what we do and do not do) and freeze the initial regulatory perimeter assumptions.

title: Outsourcing and dependency list
description: Inventory of all third parties and dependencies (Stripe, Wise, Sumsub, background checks provider, hosting, etc), including roles and data/funds touchpoints.

title: Glossary of terms
description: Single source of truth for key definitions used across the pack (capital, admin fee, reserve, insurance, award, pot, member funds, etc).

title: Funds Flow Map
description: One-page diagram and narrative of end-to-end funds movement (actors, accounts, timing, amounts, controls, exceptions).

title: PSRs Schedule 1 mapping
description: One-page mapping of Consorcia activities to the Payment Services Regulations 2017 Schedule 1 payment service categories (in-scope/out-of-scope rationale).

title: SPI eligibility and constraints note
description: Document SPI eligibility assumptions and constraints (UK-only, transaction limits, reporting approach, scope boundaries).

title: Customer money ownership and purpose statement
description: Plain-English statement of who benefits from funds at each stage, permitted uses of member funds, and separation from operating funds.

title: Client Funds Policy
description: Policy covering segregation, commingling prohibition, permitted movements, fee sweeps, refunds, and oversight responsibilities.

title: Safeguarding arrangements document
description: How member funds are protected in practice: accounts, controls, reconciliations, and failure scenarios.

title: Reconciliation procedure
description: Procedure and templates to reconcile platform ledger vs Wise vs Stripe settlement reports, with cadence, sign-off, and exception handling.

title: Access control matrix
description: Least-privilege access model for Stripe, Wise, AWS, and admin dashboard, with roles and permissions documented.

title: Payment approval procedure
description: Maker-checker style approvals for awards, refunds, and admin fee sweeps, including audit trail and evidence retention.

title: Reserve and insurance governance note
description: Rules, triggers, approvals, and logging for reserve usage and insurance handling (including what insurance is not used for).

title: Operations manual (runbooks)
description: Operational runbooks for monthly cycles, collections, award selection triggers, payouts, exceptions, and comms.

title: Refunds and exits procedure
description: Procedure for members leaving pre-award (notice period, deductions, calculations, payout SLA, evidence).

title: Missed payments and default procedure
description: Procedure for late/missed payments, exclusion criteria, default after award, escalation steps, and recovery approach.

title: Complaints policy and log template
description: Complaints handling policy with logging template, response targets, escalation, and outcomes recording.

title: Customer communications pack
description: Templates for key customer communications (DD notices, award notices, refund confirmations, exception notices).

title: Business-wide AML and financial crime risk assessment
description: Risk assessment covering customer types, products, channels, geographies (UK), and key risks/controls.

title: AML/CTF policy
description: Policy covering CDD, sanctions/PEP screening approach, escalation, SAR decision log, and record keeping.

title: Onboarding SOP (ID and manual review)
description: Step-by-step onboarding procedure: ID document, selfie, proof of address, human review, approvals, and audit trail.

title: Transaction monitoring rules
description: Simple, proportionate monitoring rules, thresholds, flags, and review workflow for suspicious patterns.

title: Record keeping and retention policy
description: Retention periods and storage locations for records, evidence, logs, communications, and audit data.

title: Training plan and log
description: Training plan and evidence log for AML, fraud, safeguarding, and operations (even if founder-only initially).

title: Governance and responsibilities matrix (RACI)
description: RACI for safeguarding, approvals, AML, operations, incident response, vendor oversight, and reporting.

title: Fit and proper pack
description: Fit and proper documentation for controllers and key roles (CV, experience narrative, declarations).

title: Conflicts of interest policy
description: Policy for identifying, declaring, and managing conflicts, including decision documentation.

title: Policies index
description: Single index listing all governance/compliance policies and where they live, with version control.

title: Decision log template
description: Template for capturing key decisions (reserve use, exceptions, refunds, write-offs) with rationale and approver.

title: Information security policy and standards
description: Security policy with measurable standards covering access control, logging, patching, secrets, and AWS posture.

title: Incident response plan
description: Incident response plan including detection, triage, containment, comms, post-incident review, and evidence retention.

title: Change management and release policy
description: Policy and workflow for controlled changes, approvals, testing, rollbacks, and audit trail.

title: Business continuity and disaster recovery summary
description: BCP/DR summary: recovery objectives, backups, restore tests, dependency failure plans.

title: Third-party risk register and due diligence pack
description: Register and due diligence evidence for Stripe, Wise, Sumsub, and other vendors, including monitoring cadence.

title: Wind-down plan
description: Plan for orderly wind-down: triggers, stopping collections, returning funds, comms, and responsibilities.

title: Wind-down communications templates
description: Templates for member communications during wind-down or major service disruption.

title: Provider termination and account freeze runbook
description: Runbook for Wise/Stripe restriction scenarios: operational steps, customer comms, and evidence capture.

title: Programme of operations
description: End-to-end narrative of the service and customer journey, payments flow, controls, and operational procedures.

title: Business plan and financial projections
description: Business plan with 12-24 month projections, revenue model (admin fees), volumes, and resourcing assumptions.

title: Safeguarding pack compilation
description: Compiled safeguarding pack combining policies, account structure, reconciliation evidence, and controls.

title: Compliance pack compilation
description: Compiled compliance pack including AML, complaints, governance, security, and wind-down materials.

title: Evidence annex
description: Annex of templates and sample filled evidence (reconciliations, approvals, logs, sample comms).

title: Submission checklist and version control log
description: Final submission checklist and version history for all documents and evidence included in the application pack.
